steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The AQA 8236 written paper is 1 hour 30 minutes and is worth 40% of the total GCSE grade | Key Fact: Read all questions before starting — plan your time based on marks available per question | Key Fact: Spend approximately 1.5 minutes per mark as a rough guide for timing | Key Fact: Always plan extended answers before writing — a brief outline saves time and improves structure

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from written exam technique, and one past-paper question.
